posts.title: Love & Basketball: The Teammate Couples Tournament
posts.week: 8 pairs · 1 bracket · W Score Pair Edition
posts.imageAlt: Paige Bueckers and Azzi Fudd together in Dallas Wings uniforms
posts.dek: Eight WNBA connected couples enter a head to head teammate résumé tournament, with real basketball photos, a transparent Pair W Score and live 2026 individual W Scores.

sections.title: Basketball only
paragraphs: The bracket does not score anyone's relationship. Pair W Score grades only shared team success, collective peak, basketball fit, teammate longevity and big stage impact.

sections.title: The No. 1 seed
paragraphs: Diana Taurasi and Penny Taylor enter at 99 after sharing three Phoenix Mercury championships. Courtney Vandersloot and Allie Quigley lead the other side of the bracket after a decade of Chicago chemistry and the 2021 WNBA title.

debates: Is three shared WNBA championships enough to make Taurasi and Taylor untouchable?
How high can Bueckers and Fudd climb if Dallas turns their college chemistry into WNBA success?
Does Williams and Johannes have the best pure basketball fit in the field?
